reviewItem.question: For "Default exception settings: the Helm chart values of the prior versions enabled exceptions by default for all namespaces", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: In Kyverno 1.13.0 the Helm chart's default exception settings change: the chart values of prior versions enabled policy exceptions by default for all namespaces, which created a potential security issue (CVE-2024-48921), and users who relied on policy exceptions being enabled in all namespaces are impacted.
